```{r}
df2 |> filter(census_year == "2010") |>
  select(
    census_year,
    area_code,
    area_name,
    entities_total,
    entities_over_5_0ha,
    share_over_5_0ha
  ) |>
  arrange( desc(share_over_5_0ha))
```

```{r}
area_classification <- df |>
  mutate(
    census_year = as.integer(census_year)
  ) |>
  group_by(area_code) |>
  slice_max(
    order_by = census_year,
    n = 1,
    with_ties = FALSE
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(area_code, area_name) |>
  arrange(area_code) |>
  mutate(
    coastal_area = NA_integer_,
    judgment = NA_character_,
    note = NA_character_
  )


area_classification |>
  count(area_code) |>
  filter(n > 1)

write_xlsx(
  area_classification,
  "area_classification.xlsx"
)
```


```{r}
large_farm_summary <- df2 |>
  group_by(census_year) |>
  summarise(
    entities_total = sum(entities_total, na.rm = TRUE),
    entities_over_5_0ha = sum(entities_over_5_0ha, na.rm = TRUE),
    share_over_5_0ha =
      entities_over_5_0ha / entities_total * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  )
large_farm_summary
```
